title: クローラー式小型運搬車
description: 狭い造園通路や補修工事の土砂運搬シーン向けクローラー式運搬車。二本の短い履帯に駆動輪・支持ローラー・靴板を備え、開口した厚肉の台形荷台には傾斜側壁、縁材、前部ダンプ軸と床下シリンダーを造形しています。後部原動機ケースに接続した立ち乗り足場、支持付き操作盤、走行・傾斜レバー、配管、冷却格子を備えた一式1モデル。荷台は下ろした固定姿勢で荷物は含みません。走行・ダンプ・油圧・積載動作、実機性能・荷重・安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.165 × 1.434 × 2.567 m、22,740三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A compact tracked dump-carrier prop for narrow landscaping paths and repair-work material scenes. Two short crawler belts include end wheels, carrier rollers and tread shoes. The genuinely open thick-walled tapered tub has sloped sides, rim rails, front tipping pivots and an underfloor cylinder. A rear engine case supports a rear standing platform, mounted control console, travel and tipping levers, conduits and cooling grille. The whole assembly counts once. Its tub is fixed in a lowered empty pose. Driving, dumping, hydraulic and load-handling operation, real-machine performance, load capacity and safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.165 × 1.434 × 2.567 m; 22,740 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
